title: Terms of Use
body:
Version 1.3 · effective 30 August 2026 · applies to all users of Urb TecTrack™

IMPORTANT — PLEASE READ
These Terms of Use (“Terms”) govern access to and use of the Urb TecTrack™ software platform operated by Urbeno Private Limited (“Urbeno”, “we”, “us”). By signing in, clicking accept, or continuing to use the platform, you confirm that you are authorised by your organisation to do so and that you accept these Terms on behalf of yourself and, where applicable, your employer.

1. Nature of the platform (no service contract)
Urb TecTrack™ is a digital record-keeping, workflow and communication tool used to capture and track information about the collection, transport, receipt, processing and certification of end-of-life electrical and electronic equipment. THE PLATFORM IS NOT ITSELF A CONTRACT FOR RECYCLING, LOGISTICS, DESTRUCTION OR ANY OTHER PHYSICAL SERVICE. Commercial terms for those services (pricing, SLAs, indemnities, insurance, liability caps for the physical work) are set only in a separate written agreement between your organisation and Urbeno. If anything displayed in the platform conflicts with that agreement, the written agreement prevails.

2. No warranty; “as available”
The platform is provided on an “AS IS” and “AS AVAILABLE” basis. To the fullest extent permitted by applicable Indian law, Urbeno disclaims all warranties, whether express, implied or statutory, including merchantability, fitness for a particular purpose, non-infringement, uninterrupted availability, and error-free operation. We do not warrant that data displayed will be complete or current at every moment, that notifications will always arrive, or that third-party systems (email, SMS gateways, browsers, networks) will function without interruption.

3. Who may use it
Access is granted only to named individuals authorised by Urbeno at the request of an authorised representative of your organisation. Accounts are personal and non-transferable. You must not share credentials. You are responsible for activity under your login. Notify info@urbeno.in promptly if you suspect compromise or if a colleague should lose access (for example on resignation). Urbeno may suspend or revoke access at any time for security, non-payment, misuse, or at your organisation’s request.

4. Your organisation’s responsibility for users and data entered
Your organisation is responsible for (a) designating who may access the platform, (b) the accuracy of information those users enter (weights, descriptions, references, contacts, GST details, declarations), and (c) ensuring use complies with applicable law and your internal policies. Approximate figures at request stage are expected; invoicing and compliance documents use the weighed net (or recorded manual method). Discrepancies and explanations are recorded against the invoice where applicable.

5. Documents issued or stored through the platform
• Form 6 manifests are issued under Rule 12 of the E-Waste (Management) Rules, 2022, typically one per invoice.
• Certificates of Destruction are prepared outside the platform, signed, and uploaded here. Several may be issued against a single request where material belongs to different departments.
• Material receipt notes are internal gate documents retained by Urbeno and may not be visible to client users.
Downloaded files are copies of records held by Urbeno. If a downloaded copy differs from our retained original, the original governs. Platform-generated PDFs and reports are tools to assist compliance reporting; they do not replace statutory filings your organisation must make to regulators in its own capacity.

6. Service levels displayed in the platform
Targets shown in the platform (for example Certificate of Destruction within thirty (30) days of receipt at a processing facility) are operational service commitments measured for transparency. Unless expressly stated in your written service agreement, they are NOT contractual warranties and do not create liquidated damages. Targets do not apply where delay arises from incomplete documentation, regulatory hold, force majeure, or matters outside Urbeno’s reasonable control.

7. Payment and closure
Invoice due dates follow the payment terms agreed with your organisation. The platform may send payment reminders after terms elapse. A request may be marked complete only when related invoices are paid in full, unless Urbeno agrees otherwise in writing.

8. Acceptable use
You must not: access another organisation’s records; upload malware or unlawful content; scrape, resell or republish platform data without written consent; attempt to bypass security or rate limits; or use the platform for any purpose other than managing consignments with Urbeno.

9. Intellectual property
The platform, design, software and the Urbeno / Recycling Heroes™ marks belong to Urbeno Private Limited or its licensors. Your consignment data and documents issued to you remain associated with your organisation; you may export them from Reports subject to access controls.

10. Limitation of liability (platform)
Nothing in these Terms excludes liability that cannot lawfully be limited under Indian law (including fraud or wilful misconduct). SUBJECT TO THAT, URBENO IS NOT LIABLE FOR ANY INDIRECT, INCIDENTAL, SPECIAL, PUNITIVE, EXEMPLARY OR CONSEQUENTIAL LOSS (INCLUDING LOST PROFITS, BUSINESS INTERRUPTION, LOSS OF DATA, OR REGULATORY PENALTIES INCURRED BY YOUR ORGANISATION) ARISING FROM USE OF OR INABILITY TO USE THE PLATFORM. URBENO’S AGGREGATE LIABILITY ARISING FROM THE PLATFORM ITSELF (AS DISTINCT FROM THE PHYSICAL RECYCLING SERVICES) IS LIMITED TO CORRECTING THE AFFECTED PLATFORM RECORDS OR, AT THAT IS NOT REASONABLY POSSIBLE, TO INR 10,000 (TEN THOUSAND RUPEES) IN THE AGGREGATE. Liability for physical recycling, transport and related services is governed solely by your separate service agreement with Urbeno.

11. Indemnity
To the extent permitted by law, your organisation shall indemnify and hold harmless Urbeno and its directors, employees and agents from claims, losses and expenses (including reasonable legal fees) arising out of (a) inaccurate or unlawful data entered by your users, (b) unauthorised use of accounts issued to your organisation, or (c) your organisation’s breach of these Terms or applicable law — except to the extent caused by Urbeno’s wilful misconduct.

12. Privacy and personal data
Processing of personal data is described in the Privacy & Data Notice. Acceptance of that Notice is required to use the platform.

13. Changes
We may update these Terms as the platform or law develops. Material changes are notified by email and/or on next sign-in and may require explicit re-acceptance. Continued use after notice constitutes acceptance where permitted by law.

14. Governing law and jurisdiction
These Terms are governed by the laws of India. Subject to mandatory remedies under the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023, the courts at Bengaluru, Karnataka have exclusive jurisdiction.

15. Contact
Questions about these Terms: info@urbeno.in.

title: Privacy & Data Notice
body:
Version 1.3 · effective 30 August 2026 · Urbeno Private Limited

1. Who we are
Urbeno Private Limited (“Urbeno”, “we”) operates Urb TecTrack™. For questions or Data Principal requests under the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 (DPDPA), write to info@urbeno.in with the subject “DPDPA request”.

2. Scope and roles
This Notice explains how we process personal data when you use Urb TecTrack. Your employer or client organisation typically decides who may access the platform (it is often the Data Fiduciary for employee/contact data it asks us to host). Urbeno processes that data to provide the platform and related e-waste services, and is a Data Fiduciary for account security, audit logs, and our own compliance records.

3. What we hold
• Platform users: name, work email, phone (if supplied), organisation and site assignments, role, feature access, password hash (never plaintext), MFA secret (if enrolled), last sign-in, periodic email-verification timestamps, and activity/audit records.
• Consignments: material descriptions, weights, photographs, vehicle/driver details where recorded, site contacts, GSTIN and addresses of sites, and compliance documents.
• Device identifiers: serial numbers or asset tags where captured, plus sanitisation method. We do not access, copy or retain the contents of storage media entrusted to us for destruction.

4. Purposes
We use personal data to: operate Urb TecTrack and the recycling service; issue manifests, certificates and related documents; meet E-Waste (Management) Rules, 2022 and our CPCB / State PCB authorisation conditions; communicate about consignments, invoices, security and product updates; verify that work emails remain active (periodic email OTP); prevent misuse; and enforce our Terms of Use.

5. Legal basis
Processing is based on performance of our contract with your organisation, compliance with legal obligations, legitimate use for security and audit, and your consent where required (including acceptance of this Notice).

6. Where data is stored
Production platform data is hosted in India. We do not transfer platform personal data outside India without your organisation’s written agreement or a legal requirement.

7. Retention
• Consignment records, manifests and receipt notes — at least five (5) years (Rule 12(4), E-Waste Rules).
• Certificates of Destruction — ten (10) years.
• Activity and audit records — seven (7) years.
• Sign-in and security logs — one (1) year, unless longer retention is needed for investigation.
• Password-reset and login email OTP codes — until used or expired (typically fifteen minutes).
• Account records — for the life of the account plus a reasonable wind-down period after deactivation.

8. Sharing
We do not sell personal data. We share it only with authorised Urbeno staff, your organisation’s named users (within their scope), contracted hosting/email providers under confidentiality, and regulators or courts when legally required.

9. Your rights (DPDPA)
You may request access, correction, and erasure where we are not required to retain data for legal or contractual reasons. You may withdraw consent where processing is consent-based, without affecting prior lawful processing. Contact info@urbeno.in. We aim to respond within thirty (30) days. You may escalate to the Data Protection Board of India as provided under applicable law.

10. Security measures
Individual accounts with passwords stored only as cryptographic hashes; optional authenticator-app MFA for staff roles; session cookies that are HttpOnly; lockout after repeated failed sign-ins; rate limiting; TLS in transit on deployed environments; audit trails for material changes. No method is perfectly secure; you must keep credentials confidential.

11. Cookies
We store a session identifier and interface preferences. We do not use advertising or third-party tracking cookies.

12. Children
The platform is intended for adult business users. We do not knowingly collect personal data from children.

13. Disclaimer
This Notice describes our practices in good faith. It is not legal advice to your organisation. Your organisation remains responsible for its own privacy notices to employees and for lawful collection of data it asks us to process.

14. Changes
We may update this Notice when practices or law change. Material updates are notified on sign-in and may require renewed acceptance. The version on this page is the version in force.

title: Compliance Notice
body:
Regulatory basis on which Urbeno Private Limited operates as an authorised e-waste recycler

Authorisations (enter production values in Masters → Company & Letterhead)
• CPCB EPR registration — as recorded on the company profile
• State PCB (e.g. KSPCB) authorisation — as recorded on the company / factory profile
• R2 / ISO certifications — as recorded on the company profile where applicable
• GSTIN / CIN / PAN — as recorded on the company statutory profile

Demo or placeholder numbers shown in non-production environments are for testing only and must be replaced before go-live.

Processing sites
Material is processed only at facilities authorised for the category concerned. Each site carries its own consent order, authorised category list and capacity limits. Urb TecTrack warns — and records an override with approver — before a category is processed beyond its authorised annual capacity.

Documents you are entitled to
• A Form 6 manifest for each invoice, issued under Rule 12 of the E-Waste (Management) Rules, 2022.
• A Certificate of Destruction for material processed (one or more per request where departments differ).
• Weighment evidence for each vehicle, or a recorded reason where a weighbridge could not be used.
• Sustainability and impact statements, with methodology published alongside figures.

Environmental claims
Figures in sustainability and Recycling Heroes™ sections are computed from completed consignments using published conversion factors cited in the methodology document. They are not carbon credits, offsets or tradable instruments and have not been registered with a crediting body.

No regulatory advice
Information in this platform supports operational record-keeping. It does not constitute legal, tax or environmental advisory services. Your organisation remains responsible for its own statutory filings and EPR obligations.

Raising a concern
Compliance queries, facility visit requests, or concerns about how a consignment was handled should be sent to info@urbeno.in or our published support number. Facility visits can be arranged with reasonable notice.
